item.title: Middle East live: Iran warns of a harsh response to anticipated US sanctions

item.title: US sanctions 'unlikely to get Tehran to bow down' despite effect on population
item.description: Iran has warned that Tehran would respond harshly to expanded U.S. sanctions, including measures against countries it sees as cooperating with Washington. The expanded sanctions come after weeks of impasse. The United States has not dislodged Iran’s grip on the Strait of Hormuz, through which a fifth of the world’s traded oil passed before the war started nearly six months ago. Now, Washington is hoping the extra sanctions will bring change. FRANCE 24's Reza Sayah tells us about the atmosphere in Iran, from Tehran. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: ‘A cognitive cacophony’: hands-on with the Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 beta test
item.description: Players will get what they expect from the new CoD title: boots-on-the-ground military action with a slight tactical edge. But what’s with all the distractions? There’s a lot riding on this year’s Call of Duty, the inescapable first-person shootfest that’s been lobbing a grenade into the autumn release schedule since 2003. Previous instalment, Black Ops 7, performed poorly compared to previous titles, forcing Activision to post a semi-apology to fans. And that’s not the only challenge Modern Warfare 4 is facing: there’s a new indie shooter, Wardogs, promising a feel somewhere between classic… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.title: SCALP, el misil de largo alcance que el Reino Unido ayudará a fabricar en Ucrania
item.description: El Reino Unido dará un nuevo paso en su apoyo militar a Ucrania al permitir que el fabricante europeo MBDA desclasifique información sobre componentes británicos del misil de crucero SCALP (por sus siglas en francés), con el objetivo de facilitar su producción en territorio ucraniano. Dicho misil es conocido en el Reino Unido como 'Storm Shadow'. Se trata de un misil de crucero lanzado desde aeronaves y diseñado para atacar objetivos terrestres de alto valor situados a larga distancia. item.title: 'Scared to death': Over 40,000 people evacuated as Nevada's Hawk fire spreads
item.description: An additional 45,000 people have been placed under evacuation warnings in the northwestern US state of Nevada. This comes as the fast moving Hawk fire threatens the city of Reno. According to officials the fire was "human caused", but they have not detailed if it was set intentionally. Eight hundred firefighters have been mobilized to bring the blazes under control. Unpredictable winds have complicated the effort, and so far there's been zero percent containment. Fuente: France 24 - English.
